summary: Configured /srv/inventory as a persistent bind mount at /mnt/inventory on node1. It automatically recovered after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Created /srv/inventory and /mnt/inventory as root-owned mode 0755 directories.
Added one validated /etc/fstab entry: /srv/inventory /mnt/inventory none bind 0 0.
Mounted the bind mount and verified matching source/target data and filesystem identity.
Safely rebooted node1, confirmed its boot ID changed, and verified full recovery.

evidence.summary: The directories exist, fstab has exactly one bind entry, validation succeeded, and the live target maps to /srv/inventory.
The mount unit is active; source and target exposed identical data and matching device/inode identities.

Healthy baseline boot ID fb2aa416-d036-46d3-aeb8-30c65a01cb34 was captured, the native reboot was acknowledged, boot ID changed to eee0f872-f1d3-47b7-812c-079c16de2e53, and the active mount plus retained test data recovered.
